display_name: T1 Android hors ligne — téléphone 2 Go
scope: capture, assembly and export on the customer's phone without a remote render server

engine_policy.preferred_android_backend: AndroidX Media3 Transformer + MediaCodec + one custom GlEffect
engine_policy.composition_model: one EditedMediaItemSequence containing S1, S2, S3 and S4
engine_policy.ffmpeg_policy: not the primary engine; an alternative port is accepted only if it passes the same conformance pack
engine_policy.reference_backend: Python/OpenCV/Pillow is for reproducibility and golden-master generation, not the mobile runtime

capture_profile.orientation: portrait 9:16; rotation metadata normalized before assembly

export_profile.audio_phase: deferred; merchant voice timing remains reserved at 1.0x

resource_budgets.text_rasterization: once per unique text block, never once per frame
resource_budgets.temporary_files: one output-in-progress plus bounded metadata; delete on success, cancellation or failure

FULL.selection: device meets all hardware requirements and thermal state is normal
rules: use the exact timing and parameters in premium_transition_choreography
keep every cut, event name, event duration, transform, text, color and CTA frame unchanged
execute bloom and Gaussian softness on a half-resolution intermediate and composite once
combine warm flash, sweep and chromatic uniforms in one custom GlEffect pass
replace local contrast with one lightweight sharpen pass or omit it when the encoder is under sustained load
never degrade face safety, text sharpness, price formatting or the final CTA

thermal_and_lifecycle.background_behavior: persist accepted capture URIs; pause or cancel the active export according to the host application's foreground-service policy
thermal_and_lifecycle.thermal_moderate: force LOW_END_2GB tier and prohibit concurrent renders
thermal_and_lifecycle.thermal_severe: pause before starting a new encoder stage and return a retryable local error if the device cannot cool
thermal_and_lifecycle.low_battery: no network fallback; host application may require charging before starting
thermal_and_lifecycle.process_death: discard partial output, preserve accepted input URIs and allow deterministic restart

non_degradable_invariants: source and merchant-voice time maps remain identity
no crossfade, frame blending, speed ramp, freeze or automatic subtitle
DM Serif Display and Montserrat remain bundled and checksum-verified
CTA remains fully visible through frame 899

checks: stay within the hard memory budget
verify restart after cancellation and process death
